project.title: BRINE-MINE: Struvite-route mineral recovery and energy-reduced ZLD for desalination brine
project.lineage: ReThink Brine Challenge 2020-21, team NGSTA (Next-Generation STrustainable Aqua)
project.abstract: Partial struvite crystallisation (P/Mg 0.3-0.4) with Mg(OH)2 co-precipitation removes the divalent foulants from SWRO brine at ambient conditions, yielding a magnesium-phosphate cement precursor (MgHPO4 / newberyite + MgO after mild decomposition, NH3 recycled). The cleaned Na/K-Cl brine is then concentrated by high-pressure or series RO before evaporation, cutting evaporator thermal energy by ~55% (prelim. mass balance). Optional valorisation: NaCl, Solvay soda ash, CaCl2 road salt, potash.
project.status: Bench proof of concept on synthetic brine; programme being reconstituted
project.testnetNotice: Funding on Sepolia is test ETH only; no real value.
